summaries.summary: The image displays a Venn diagram illustrating the three key skill areas of a Business Intelligence Competence Center (BICC), labeled as Business Skills, Analytic Skills, and IT Skills. Each area contains specific sub-skills and responsibilities, with overlapping sections indicating shared competencies.
key_facts: There are three main types of BICC Key Skills: Business Skills, Analytic Skills, and IT Skills.
Business Skills include Business Needs and Organization and Processes.
Analytic Skills include Business Needs, Statistical and Process Skills, and User Skills.
IT Skills include Governance, Administration, Tools, Infrastructure, Applications, and Data.
The central overlapping area is labeled 'BICC' and includes 'Organize Methodology Leadership' and 'Manage Programs'.
